meta.title: 读书三问法｜用第一性原理读透一本书

scenes.context: 讲者把视频当作礼物送给想成长的人，指出读书要解决读不进去、记不住、做不到三个问题。
sentences: 这份礼物，就是告诉你读书的方法。
This gift is about showing you how to read.
告诉你读书的方法：show you how to read
读书要解决三个问题：读不进去、记不住、做不到。
Reading solves three problems: can't get into it, can't remember it, can't act on it.
三个问题：three problems
想提升读书能力，先从方法入手。
To read better, start with the method.
提升读书能力：read better
paraphrase: 「解决三个问题」→ 逐个击破
Tackle the three problems one by one.
「送给想成长的人」→ 分享给成长中的人
A gift for anyone who wants to grow.
scenes.speak: This gift is about showing you how to read. Reading solves three problems: can't get into it, can't remember it, can't act on it. To read better, start with the method.

scenes.context: 讲者强调一本书最重要的是知道作者为什么写、用什么认知方式思考，并以鲁迅散文为例说明中心思想的重要性。
sentences: 一本书最重要的，是知道作者为什么写这本书。
The most important thing is knowing why the author wrote the book.
为什么写这本书：why the author wrote it
不知道中心思想，每句话都像普通文章。
Without the central idea, every line feels ordinary.
中心思想：the central idea
语文学了十二年，老师教的就是这个能力。
Twelve years of Chinese class were teaching exactly this skill.
老师教的能力：the skill your teacher taught
paraphrase: 「作者的认知方式」→ 作者的思维框架
「放在那个环境里看」→ 结合语境理解
Understand it in its original context.
scenes.speak: The most important thing is knowing why the author wrote the book. Without the central idea, every line feels ordinary. Twelve years of Chinese class were teaching exactly this skill.

scenes.title_en: First principles see through the book
scenes.context: 讲者以《价值》为例，指出长期主义的本质是第一性原理——每个事情都能倒到一个唯一的原因，并以加入/离开公司与投资爱奇艺举例。
sentences: 长期主义的前提，是第一性原理。
Long-termism rests on first principles.
长期主义：long-termism
第一性原理，就是每件事都能倒到一个唯一的原因。
First principles means tracing everything back to a single root cause.
唯一的原因：a single root cause
加入公司的起因，和你离开的原因是一致的。
Why you joined a company and why you leave it are the same.
起因和离开原因一致：the same reason behind joining and leaving
paraphrase: 「倒到一个唯一的原因」→ 追根溯源
Trace everything back to one root.
「这事干成了还是换方向了」→ 判断何时结束
Know when the bet pays off or pivots.
scenes.speak: Long-termism rests on first principles. First principles means tracing everything back to a single root cause. Why you joined a company and why you leave it are the same.

scenes.title_en: Read three chapters deeply, skim the rest
scenes.context: 讲者总结：详读三章后底层逻辑就出来了，带着它快读其余章节，记住一个关键点就能记住全书脉络。
sentences: 详读三章，这本书的底层逻辑就出来了。
Read three chapters deeply and the book's core logic emerges.
底层逻辑：the core logic
带着底层逻辑再读，就叫快读。
Reading with that logic in mind is fast reading.
快读：fast reading
记住一个关键点，整个脉络就成型了。
Hold onto one key point and the whole structure takes shape.
关键点：key point
scenes.speak: Read three chapters deeply and the book's core logic emerges. Reading with that logic in mind is fast reading. Hold onto one key point and the whole structure takes shape.

practice: I start by understanding why the author wrote this book.
I take three lines of notes: the point, the evidence, and the reasoning.
I trace the decision back to its first principle.
I read a few chapters deeply, then skim the rest with the framework in mind.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：This gift tells you reading's method.
✓ 地道说法：This gift is about showing you how to read.
method 的直译腔过重，show you how to read 更自然。
✕ 直译腔：I can't read into the book.
✓ 地道说法：I can't get into the book.
get into 是表达「读不进去」的地道说法。
✕ 直译腔：Trace to a unique reason.
✓ 地道说法：Trace it back to a single root cause.
root cause 比 unique reason 更地道。
✕ 直译腔：The book's bottom layer logic.
✓ 地道说法：The book's core logic / underlying logic.
底层逻辑用 core logic 或 underlying logic。
shifts: 从第一页开始逐字硬啃，读不进去就放弃
先读序言目录懂作者框架，从最感兴趣的章节开读
每章合上书写「事、证、思」三行记录
把长期主义当口号反复念
追问其第一性原理：底层唯一原因是什么，何时失效
footer_notes: 原片为繁体中文口述，转录已转换为简体；ASR 专有名词已按语境校正（如「此经未下」按上下文理解为「死记硬背式阅读」的口误、「辯證統一」等句未作为结论引用）。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
